parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment explicitly states two actions: (1) present the SOC derivation in the main paper instead of the appendix, and (2) explain a simpler setting before the full generalization. These are direct suggestions, not implicit. The actions are also concrete: authors know exactly what structural modifications to apply—moving the SOC derivation into the main paper and restructuring the presentation so that an easier-to-notation setting is explained first, followed by the full-fledged generalization. These are clear, implementable reorganization instructions, and demanding further granular detail goes beyond what the rubric requires. The comment therefore satisfies the rubric condition in which an explicit action is combined with concrete details on how to implement it.
